name: Parallel park
summary: A two-minute parallel parking game on a street drawn from above: drag the car into the gap between two parked cars and park it; closer to the middle scores higher, friends' tries stay as ghost cars with their faces, and the best score gets the spot.
useWhen: teasing someone's parking in the chat: 'calvin took 9 tries to park the sube'
a quick game to settle who gets the good parking spot
something light to play while waiting on someone
dontUseWhen: planning rides or who drives (use carpool)
a real parking ticket to split (use ticket-peel)
a game with questions or trivia (use trivia-night)

car.description: The car everyone parks, e.g. 'the Sube'

tries.description: Earlier tries in thousandths of the street; the spot's middle is x 390, y 300
